title: "Fix" MacBook Neo Cursor Lag: Record 1 Pixel of the Screen Every 10 Seconds
summary: A creative shell script workaround that fixes MacBook cursor/trackpad lag by continuously capturing just 1 pixel of screen every 10 seconds using macOS screen recording, which prevents the system from throttling graphics resources.
problem_solved: Fixes the annoying cursor lag issue that many MacBook users experience due to graphics driver or power management quirks.
why_valuable: It provides a simple, free, and clever workaround for a frustrating hardware issue that Apple hasn't officially addressed, leveraging an unexpected side effect of screen recording APIs.
